regions.today: Mostly cloudy, but sunny spells developing through the afternoon. Highest temperatures of 20 to 24 degrees, warmest in the south, with light to moderate northerly breezes.
regions.tonight: Dry tonight with plenty of clear spells. Becoming cloudier towards morning, mainly over the north of the province. Lowest temperatures of 9 to 11 degrees in a light to moderate northerly breeze.
regions.tomorrow: A generally cloudy start tomorrow, with the best of any early sunshine in the south. Sunny spells will become more widespread through the afternoon and evening. Highest temperatures of 21 to 23 degrees, in light, occasionally moderate, northerly breezes.
